facts.text: The resort's villas and suites frame Phu Quoc's Long Beach.
facts.excerpt: contemporary design cues that perfectly frame Phu Quoc’s long beach

facts.text: Accommodation is all-pool villas and suites.
facts.excerpt: Find refuge in our thoughtfully appointed, all-pool villas and suites around the resort

facts.text: The Three Bedroom Beach Pool Villa sits directly on the white sands of Long Beach, with a living and kitchen area and unobstructed sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Placed directly upon the white sands of Long Beach, offering an airy living and kitchen area with mesmerising, unobstructed sunset views.

facts.text: Sky Pool Villas use a vertical villa concept in the Sky Wing, with panoramic resort views and a private infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Take full advantage of the unique vertical villa concept in these discreetly opulent rooms. This villa is situated in the Sky Wing with panoramic resort views and offers splendid indoor and outdoor spaces and private infinity pool.

facts.text: Oku is the signature restaurant, serving contemporary Japanese-French cuisine with an Omakase Atelier and Salon de Boeuf.
facts.excerpt: Our signature dining restaurant, featuring an Omakase Atelier and Salon de Boeuf, serves contemporary Japanese-French cuisine

facts.text: Rice Market celebrates rice, serving rice and noodle dishes with Vietnamese herbs, spices and recipes.
facts.excerpt: A celebration of the humblest ingredient in Vietnamese cuisine: Rice. Showcasing the diversity of such a simple staple, in the form of Rice and Noodle dishes

facts.text: Fu Bar is an adults-only sky pool terrace and rooftop bar with a gin and herb-focused cocktail menu.
facts.excerpt: Unwind under the sun and stars at the adults-only sky pool terrace and rooftop bar. Explore the gin and herb-focused cocktail menu.

facts.text: Ocean Club is a beach club with rum-inspired cocktails and poolside lounging with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Soak up the beach club vibe with our specially curated menu and rum-inspired cocktails. Lounge poolside with framed views of the ocean

facts.text: Bar Jade is a speakeasy cocktail bar tucked away in a hidden nook within the resort.
facts.excerpt: with a laidback speakeasy cocktail bar. Discreetly tucked away in a hidden nook within the resort

facts.text: The spa has a Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by podiatrist Bastien Gonzalez.
facts.excerpt: Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by renowned podiatrist Bastien Gonzalez, focuses on the concept of the medical pedicure and manicure.

facts.text: The spa has a Biologique Recherche facial suite.
facts.excerpt: Biologique Recherche Facial Suite

facts.text: Wellness therapies use golden alpha-quartz sand.
facts.excerpt: Using golden alpha-quartz sand as a way to treat rheumatic, arthritic, and respiratory conditions

facts.text: The health club has Technogym equipment and is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a diverse range of state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, our health club is open 24 hours

facts.text: There is an adults-only rooftop infinity pool on level 10 of the Sky Wing.
facts.excerpt: Adults only Rooftop Infinity Pool, located on level 10 of the Sky Wing

facts.text: The main pool has a dedicated children's pool.
facts.excerpt: Main Pool with a dedicated children's pool

facts.text: Families have kids pools, an imagination zone, a playground and a mini-theatre zone.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the dedicated kids pools, build curious minds in the imagination zone, playground and mini-theatre zone

facts.text: The in-room Refreshment Gallery, with alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, local coffee, tea and delicacies, is included.
facts.excerpt: The in-room Refreshment Gallery, including alcoholic, and non-alcoholic beverages, local artisanal coffee, tea, and delicacies is yours to enjoy.

facts.text: Three pieces of laundry or pressing per bedroom per day are included.
facts.excerpt: Three pieces of laundry or pressing per bedroom per day

facts.text: Young guests have access to the Regent Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: Our youngest guests also receive exclusive complimentary amenities and have access to the Regent Kids Club.

facts.text: A Regent Experience Agent helps plan and personalise each stay.
facts.excerpt: Your personal Regent Experience Agent is always on hand throughout to help plan, personalise and suggest

facts.text: Personal Havens are private spaces customised with choices such as food and beverages, scent, music, literature and bath menus.
facts.excerpt: Personal Havens are customised with individual choices such as bespoke food and beverages, scent, music, literature and bath menus

facts.text: Regent Phu Quoc was recognised in the 2025 and 2026 MICHELIN Key List.
facts.excerpt: We are deeply grateful to be recognised by **MICHELIN’s 2025 and 2026 MICHELIN Key List** as one of Vietnam’s finest hotels.

facts.text: The resort sits within the Phu Quoc Marina Integrated Resort Complex.
facts.excerpt: Phu Quoc Marina Integrated Resort Complex, Duong Bao Ward, Duong To, Phu Quoc Special Zone,

facts.text: Out back is an integrated resort complex shared with the InterContinental next door and apartment blocks under construction.
facts.excerpt: Out back, an “integrated resort complex” shared with the Intercontinental next door and several clusters of apartment blocks in various states of construction.

facts.text: Most villas and some suites have a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: most of the villas (and some of the suites) come with a full kitchen

facts.text: It was the first resort under IHG to implement Regent's reimagined hallmarks.
facts.excerpt: the first resort under IHG’s stewardship to implement the brand’s reimagined hallmarks

facts.text: Fu Bar has a gin-centric drink list and nightly sax jazz.
facts.excerpt: with a gin-centric drink list and nightly sax jazz

facts.text: Phu Quoc is less culture-rich than Vietnam's other regions; consider combining a stay with a trip upcountry.
facts.excerpt: While beautiful, Phu Quoc isn’t as culture-rich as Vietnam’s other regions. Unless you’re after a fly-and-flop holiday, consider combining a stay here with a trip upcountry.

facts.text: The area around Long Beach is being developed with casinos, amusement parks and convention centers.
facts.excerpt: Local investors with big, shiny ideas and dollar signs in their eyes are building casinos, amusement parks, and convention centers by the dozen

facts.text: The Seven Bedroom Beach Pool Villa is a beachfront villa with seven suites, infinity pools and gardens, suited to families and groups.
facts.excerpt: beachfront villa blends grandeur and intimacy, with seven elegant suites, oasis-inspired bathrooms, infinity pools, and lush gardens

facts.text: Beach weddings can be held on the sands with the sunset directly in front of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The soft white sands and sunset directly in front of the hotel make Regent Phu Quoc the perfect venue for you and your guests.

contradictions.note: p7 (official) says young guests have access to the Regent Kids Club; p8 (Conde Nast review written shortly after opening) says the kids club had yet to open

sources.excerpt: have access to the Regent Kids Club
